Feature.name: Name
Feature.role: Kind of link: capital, source, alliance…
Feature.styleHint: An empty field uses the type's value.

Claims.conflictsText: These changes were made against an older map:

Check.speaker: World map
Check.title: Claim check
Check.difficultyHint: As in Vitruvium: 1 is easy, 6 is nearly impossible. Weigh what the world already holds.
Check.noActor: A character is needed: select a token or assign a character to the user.

Notify.noAtlas: This scene has no atlas yet. The GM creates it by opening the map.
Notify.featureMissing: The feature is no longer on the map.
Notify.updateAvailable: Artarius {latest} is out (you have {current}). To update: return to Foundry setup → Add-on Modules → update button on Artarius.

autoApplyOnSuccess.name: Accept a claim on success
autoApplyOnSuccess.hint: If a claim check succeeds, its changes go on the map at once. The GM decides partial successes and failures.

checkUpdates.name: Notify about new versions
checkUpdates.hint: The GM sees a message when a new module version is released on GitHub.

Guide.title: Artarius: how to play
Guide.missing: Could not load the guide. It is in the module folder: docs/GUIDE.md.

Azgaar.title: Map from Azgaar
Azgaar.gmOnly: Only the GM can import a map.
Azgaar.generateHint: The generator opens inside Foundry. Press “New Map!” until you like the map. Then press “Export”: PNG saves the picture for the background, “Export to JSON” → “Full” saves the data for import.
Azgaar.importHint: Heights and biomes become hex terrain. States, provinces, burgs, rivers and routes become zones, marks and lines on the current scene. The GM can edit them like any other.
Azgaar.replace: Replace what an earlier Azgaar import brought
Azgaar.noFile: Choose a JSON file from Azgaar.
Azgaar.done: Import done: terrain hexes {terrain}, states {states}, provinces {provinces}, burgs {burgs}, rivers {rivers}, routes {routes}.

error.notJson: This is not a JSON file.
error.noInfo: The file has no map size. An Azgaar export is needed.
error.notFull: This is not a full export. In Azgaar choose Export to JSON → Full.
error.isMap: This is a .map save, not JSON. In Azgaar: Export → Export to JSON → Full.

Azgaar.fit: Fit the scene to the map proportions
Azgaar.fitHint: The field height in hexes follows the Azgaar map so it does not stretch.

Field.name: Name
Field.typeHere: A new type applies to this hex only; the rest of the zone stays.
Field.typeHereMany: A new type applies only to the selected hexes of this zone; the rest stays.

Select.hint: Click a hex to see everything on it on the right: zones, marks, lines, their owners, statuses and aspects. Shift-click or Shift-drag inspects several hexes at once.

Layer.title: Layers
Layer.exclusiveCheck: A hex belongs to one zone of the layer
Layer.exclusiveHint: On: a new zone takes the hex from other zones of this layer, like terrain. Off: zones of the layer overlap, like regions and notes.
Layer.deleteAsk: Delete layer “{name}”? Its types ({n}) and zones move to “{to}”.
Layer.terrainHint: Terrain cannot be deleted: hex colours and the generator rely on it.
Layer.barHint: Click toggles a layer. Only you see the change.

World.sizeHint: Hex width in pixels. Bigger hexes make a bigger map at the same Foundry zoom. Zones and marks move to the new field, lines are scaled.
World.style_atlas: Atlas: paper, mountain and forest glyphs
World.styleHint: Atlas draws terrain like an old paper map: inked coastline, mountains, forests, waves on deep water. Simple fills hexes with the type color.
World.roughHint: Terrain borders are drawn wavy instead of along hex edges. Data stays per hex; realms and regions are drawn straight.
World.thumbHint: Map snapshot for the Scenes list
World.thumbFail: Could not update the scene preview, see the console (F12)

Type.personal: your type, becomes shared once approved
Type.deleteUsed: Type “{name}” is already on the map. Delete it anyway? Items stay but lose the type's look.
Type.emojiHint: When filled, the mark shows this emoji in its own colours and the icon is not used.

Zone.hint: Click or drag to select hexes, Shift to deselect. Alt-click opens a hex. Then attach the hexes to a zone.
Zone.paint: Paint directly: dragging goes straight into the zone
Zone.noCells: Select hexes on the map first.
Zone.nothingToDetach: Selected hexes have no zones on this layer.

Mark.hint: Select hexes by click or drag, pick a mark type and press Place. Each hex gets its own mark.
Mark.deletedOne: Mark “{name}” deleted. Ctrl+Z brings it back.
Mark.deletedMany: Marks deleted: {n}. Ctrl+Z brings them back.

Line.hint: Pick a mode below. Right-click removes the last point, Esc clears the line, Enter or double-click finishes it.
Line.needTwo: A line needs at least two points.

hints.free: Points go where you click. Hold Ctrl to snap a point to the hex center.
hints.hex: Click hexes: the line runs through the centers of every hex in between.
hints.draw: Drag with the mouse button held. The line is saved when you release it.
hints.edge: Click near hex corners: the line follows hex edges to each new point. Handy for borders.

Line.join: Join with a line of the same type when ends meet
Line.segment: Name of the part on this hex
Line.segmentMany: Name of the part on selected hexes
Line.segmentHint: Empty means the part uses the line name. To name a long part, select its hexes with Shift in Inspect.

Card.pick: Click a hex with Inspect, or Alt-click.
Card.empty: Nothing here yet. Use Zone, Mark or Line.
Card.multiHint: Shift-click adds or removes a hex, Shift-drag adds several. A plain click inspects one hex.
Card.removeCells: Remove selected hexes from the zone

Queue.title: Claims
Queue.draftHint: Your edits the GM hasn't seen yet
Queue.emptyDraft: Draft is empty. Everything you draw lands here first.
Queue.rejectReason: Why rejected (the player will see it):

Scene.enabledHint: Turns the scene into a hex world: blank hexes, zones, marks and lines. Needs a pointy-top (row) hex grid.
Scene.settingsHint: Only affects Artarius scenes. Terrain colours come from zone types.
Scene.createHint: Creates a new scene with a hex grid and opens it.
Scene.name: Name

Gen.title: World generator
Gen.gmOnly: Only the GM can generate a world.
Gen.hint: A whole-scene world built from pieces: continents, peninsulas, islands, ridges and inland seas by a recipe. Biomes follow heat and moisture, resources are marks, realms grow from capitals.
Gen.realmsHint: One per player by default. The player character becomes the realm demiurge.
Gen.clearHint: Delete every zone, mark and line on this scene. Unchecked, only what the generator made before is replaced.
Gen.done: World ready (seed {seed}): {hexes} hexes, {terrain} terrain zones, {realms} realms, {resources} resources, {neutral} neutral objects.
Gen.sizeHint: The scene is resized before generating.
Gen.quickHint: One button: random recipe and seed, a realm per player, ruins, lairs and groves. The scene is cleared. Every world comes out different.
Gen.neutralHint: Ruins, lairs, groves, oases and other ownerless places. 0 turns them off.

View.noData: No data: import an Azgaar map or run the generator

Icons.ownHint: Opens the Foundry file picker, where you can also upload an image. SVG, PNG and WEBP work.
Icons.tint: Tint the icon with the type color
Icons.credit: Icons: game-icons.net, CC BY 3.0. Authors in assets/icons/CREDITS.md.

Hud.multiHint: Shift-click adds or removes a hex
Hud.dragOrder: drag up or down to reorder

Settings.title: Artarius settings
Settings.pick: Pick something in the list on the left.
Settings.worldHint: Field size, rough coastlines, Azgaar import and the test map generator.

Bar.deleteHint: Delete selected marks. Ctrl+Z brings them back

Goto.title: Go to hex
Goto.hint: Enter to go, Esc to close

Size.hint: Like token size: 2×2 covers two cells. Scale only changes the look. Alt + drag places a mark anywhere.

Keys.title: Keys
Keys.shift: click a mark to add it to the selection, a hex to inspect one more
Keys.alt: drag a mark to any point

Perm.denied: Not allowed: {what}. This edit was not saved.
Perm.hint: GM and assistant GM can do everything. A player's own setting beats the role. Others' things are those this player did not create.

Vis.title: Who sees it
Vis.onlyAuthor: Only the GM or the mark's author can change visibility.

Chat.settingHint: Approved claims and GM edits are posted to chat as separate messages. Delete them like any message. Off by default: with messages, painting is slower.
